map.储蓄目标月存额计算器 使用指南: Savings Goal Monthly Deposit Calculator User Guide
map.输入储蓄目标金额、预期年利率与达成期限，反推每月需定额存入的金额，辅助制定切实可: Enter the savings target, the expected annual return and the deadline, and the tool back-calculates the fixed monthly deposit needed, helping you build a realistic saving plan.
map.填写「年利率 r (%)」。: Enter the annual interest rate r (%).
map.填写「年限 y」。: Enter the number of years y.
map.为购房首付、旅行等设定每月定存金额。: Set a fixed monthly deposit toward a down payment, a trip or another goal.
map.在给定年限与收益率下反推攒钱节奏。: Back out your saving pace for a given horizon and return rate.
map.调整目标金额或期限看月存变化。: Change the target amount or the deadline to see how the monthly deposit moves.
map.3 年攒 100,000、月利率 0.3% 的月存额: Monthly deposit to reach 100,000 in 3 years at 0.3% monthly interest
PMT = FV×r÷((1+r)^n−1) = 100,000×0.003÷((1.003)^36−1) = 300÷(1.1133−1) = 300÷0.1133 ≈ 2,648 CNY per month. Over 36 months the balance is about 95,328, and the interest tops it up to 100,000.
map.由免税品种收益率与税率求税后等效收益率: After-tax equivalent return from a tax-free product yield and tax rate
map.由名义利率与复利频率求实际年化收益率: Effective annual return from the nominal rate and the compounding frequency
map.由年利息与债券价格求当前收益率: Current yield from the annual coupon and the bond price
map.收益率设高了会怎样？: What happens if I set the return rate too high?
map.设定收益越高，所需月存越低，但实现更难。保守起见按无风险利率（货基/定存）测算，: A higher target return means a lower required monthly deposit but a harder goal. To stay conservative, measure against the risk-free rate (money market fund or time deposit) so the target is not missed.
map.能中途暂停或追加吗？: Can I pause or make extra payments part-way through?
map.能。公式给的是「恒定月存」基准，实际可用不定额（如年终奖追加）更快达成，用现金流: Yes. The formula gives a constant monthly deposit benchmark, but in practice you can reach the goal faster with irregular payments (such as adding a year-end bonus); just discount the cash flow and check each period.
